entities.name: Giulia Turco Turcati Lazzari
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Giulia Turco, or Giulia Turco Lazzari, was a baroness best known as a naturalist and writer in her native Trento, Italy. She was married to the bolognese musician Raffaello Lazzari.
